description: GET ONLY the 'Match' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. PvP / match system configuration, grouped by battle mode under InstantBattle. Holds the instant-battle rule catalogue (keyed by RuleID) plus title-wide defaults. Each rule defines wager economy (prize-pool burn) and battle settings: a combat-role → StatID mapping (which Character stat drives HP/Damage/Armor/AttackSpeed/CritChance/CritDamage/Dodge/AllMight), combat params (max rounds, block effect, crit/dodge clamps) and optional per-stat custom formulas. Stat/formula fields reference Character.Stats StatIDs; equipment bonuses (Item) key off the same StatIDs.
name: get_match
title: Get Match settings
